method: Simulated adversarial student journeys, automated Chromium interactions, visual desktop/mobile inspection and unit tests. No human student study is claimed.

scenarios.challenge: Find the next action, set a five-minute goal, pause mid-answer and resume.
scenarios.result: Passed. A clear start action, draft persistence and saved plan were exercised.

scenarios.challenge: Submit a wrong answer, correct it, replay a lesson and try to gain duplicate credit.
scenarios.result: Passed. First-attempt errors remain; completed lessons and same-day scheduled reviews cannot award duplicate credit.

scenarios.challenge: Switch language midway through a lesson and navigate the planner, notebook and sources on a phone.
scenarios.result: Passed in EN and IT; target Italian remains Italian, optional English examples are separate.

scenarios.challenge: Encounter overdue recall, answer incorrectly, correct it and check the next date.
scenarios.result: Passed. The first failed recall is recorded once and returns the next day; no streak penalty. The planner carries overdue items to the next chosen study day and respects the remaining daily budget.

scenarios.challenge: Use 390px and 320px screens, access labels and focus, navigate native keyboard controls.
scenarios.result: Passed tested layout and labelled-form journeys. Fixed calendar overflow and kept visible focus. No full assistive-technology certification is claimed.

scenarios.challenge: Block storage, exhaust its quota, load corrupt JSON, import invalid backups and restore a valid export.
scenarios.result: Passed. Memory-only practice warns explicitly; corrupt data is preserved; validated replacement is explicit.

scenarios.challenge: Change notes in a second tab and preferences in the first.
scenarios.result: Passed. Storage event synchronization retained notes.

scenarios.challenge: Follow lesson citations back to physical source pages rather than extracted-text indexes.
scenarios.result: Found shifted references caused by blank/image pages; corrected all affected mission citations.
